tweets.text:
An illegal immigrant who filmed his sexual abuse of a child just received a 30-year prison sentence.

On at least four occasions between February and March 2025, Samuel Flores de Dios, 36, sexually abused his victim, who was under the age of 13, in a rented bedroom in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, where he had positioned various cellphones to film the encounters, according to the DOJ. One of the videos also showed a second man abusing the child.

Flores de Dios crossed the Arizona border illegally in 2005 before he was “voluntarily returned” to Mexico by federal agents, DHS tells @realDailyWire. He then snuck back into the country without getting caught at a later unknown time.

DHS is now pledging to deport Flores de Dios.

“Once his sentence is complete, we will remove him from our country so that he can never harm another innocent child. Under President Trump and Secretary Mullin, we are putting the safety of the American people first,” Acting Assistant Homeland Security Secretary Lauren Bis tells us.
